## Migration Destination

> Which destination repository will own this content permanently?
> If none, explain why it cannot be assigned to an existing repository.

<!-- e.g. "Will move to cognitive-lab once X is resolved" or "Archival only — no active destination" -->


## Rationale for Placing in Scratch

> Why does this content belong here rather than directly in the destination repository?

<!-- Acceptable reasons: blocked migration, unclear ownership pending decision, temporary holding during active relocation -->
<!-- Unacceptable reasons: "easier for now", "not sure yet", "scratch is convenient" -->


## Removal Condition

> What event or decision triggers removal of this content from scratch?

<!-- Be specific: "once autonomous-task-gen/ migration to lab-experiments is merged" or "after archive decision by YYYY-MM-DD" -->


## Checklist

- [ ] This change does not add new long-term projects to scratch
- [ ] This change does not use scratch as a general sandbox for active development
- [ ] A migration destination or archival rationale is stated above
- [ ] A concrete removal condition is stated above
